releaseNotes:
v4.0.0: Major quality & performance overhaul. 

🔧 FIXES:
• D-pad focus lock resolved — returning from movie detail no longer traps focus on category rail
• Movie info 'no info detected' fixed — VodInfo now cached (15-min TTL) with 3-attempt retry; server rate-limiting no longer causes blank detail screens
• Live TV channel lag/freeze fixed — EPG batch loading capped at 40 channels on category switch; viewport-driven incremental loading prevents server request storms
• EPG batch concurrency reduced (20→10 per chunk, 100ms→200ms delay) preventing OkHttp pool saturation
• Category item keys added — focus and scroll state preserved across category switches
• Poster grid item keys added — no more full recompose on category change

⚡ PERFORMANCE:
• VOD buffer reduced from 8s to 5s — faster movie start on Firestick 4K
• VLC --http-reconnect added — auto-recovers stalled HLS segments without user intervention
• VOD/Series cache TTL extended 5min→15min — no more loading spinner while browsing
• OkHttp readTimeout reduced 60s→30s — prevents 1-minute UI freeze on stalled API calls
• Poster animation changed from spring to tween(120ms) — eliminates D-pad navigation frame drops
• Poster disk cache keyed by stream ID — CDN URL rotation no longer causes re-downloads

🎬 MOVIE DETAIL:
• 'RELOAD INFO' button added when server returns empty metadata
• Retry automatically on transient network failures (up to 3 attempts with backoff)
